scenario: A null leaf is not refused: `[{p.body.x:>8}]` where `x` is JSON `null` renders as LGRA.2.9.6.10's null does, as the empty string with no padding, so the message is `[]` and no TypeError is raised. PATH PINNED: the null arm ahead of the run-time spec check (libds `render_value`'s first line, Mercury `render_prim`'s `null` arm). A check placed ahead of the null arm would log `type error`, and padding the null would log `[        ]`.
rules_ds:
schema P scope logical:
    body: Json key

rule r:
    P p
->
    log info "[{p.body.x:>8}]"

rule handler:
    TypeError
->
    log info "type error"
